item.title: Hazardous glacial lakes need reservoir governance
item.content:encoded:
Nature Climate Change, Published online: 16 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02796-6

Climate warming is expanding thousands of glacial lakes with unstable natural dams, yet high-risk lakes remain outside formal safety oversight despite their potential for downstream harm. These lakes need consequence-based governance analogous to engineered dams and reservoirs, beginning with risk-tiered monitoring and clearer protection during conflict.
